about: Qwen3.8-27B (dense, hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention, thinking) Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL (Dynamic V3.1) with its built-in MTP head (--spec-type draft-mtp, 3 drafted tokens) on llama.cpp Metal at 131,072 tokens, one slot, on a 32 GB Apple M1 Max with the default GPU memory limit (no sysctl change). llama.cpp is Unsloth's prebuilt b12588-mix-c0c3de8 (macOS arm64), the same build as the Inkling 2 Mini recipe on this card, so the two compare directly. Metal buffers at this launch: weights 15,814 MiB, q8_0 KV 4,352 MiB (only 16 of 64 layers have KV), recurrent state 150 MiB, compute 639 MiB. MTP 3 drafts decoded 14.8-15.0 tok/s vs 10.8-11.9 without against interleaved controls (2 drafts 14.3, 4 drafts 14.4, 5 drafts 13.5), with no prefill loss. -ub 512 and 1024 did not speed up prefill. q8_0 KV: f16 at 128K (8.5 GiB) does not leave room beside the weights. --cache-ram 0 keeps llama-server's host prompt cache from adding memory pressure on a 32 GB machine. Qwen's thinking-mode sampling. Text only (no vision projector).
setup: macOS on Apple silicon with 32 GB or more. Unpack the archive into llama-b12588-mix-c0c3de8/ next to models/ and run from that directory. The launch uses about 21 GiB of the 25 GiB Metal working set; quit other memory-heavy apps first.
